purpose: Trigger-rate check for the seven sdlc-* skills. Measured once for the whole family rather than per skill, because the real activation risk here is cross-firing between siblings, not whether one skill fires in isolation.
method: Run each query cold, with all seven skills installed and none named by the user. Record which skill (if any) loads. A query with expected_skill null must load none of them. Target: >= 90% correct across the 20, and no false fire on the six 'ordinary work' queries.

known_risks: The five *-loop skills are deliberately reachable mainly through their owning agent. If the should-fire rate for loop queries lands below target, that is acceptable only while every loop keeps its 'Do not use standalone' negative trigger - otherwise the description is simply too narrow.
'implement X end to end' is the orchestrator's broadest phrase. Watch query 11 specifically: a false fire there means the negative trigger needs strengthening, not the pipeline.
